deadline.value: Complete the Graduate School application by January 22, 2027; fee waiver requests are due January 8. The FAQ still says January 10, so apply by January 10 to be safe.
deadline.quote: Application to the graduate program in Astrophysics requires completion of the Graduate School application by January 22nd, 2027.

fee_waiver.value: The institute has very limited funds to cover the application fee; email to request one by January 8.
fee_waiver.quote: We have very limited funds for the fee waiver.

also.quote: Fee waiver applications are due January 8th and decisions will be announced January 15th.

gre_general.value: A General GRE score is required for Fall 2027 applications.
gre_general.quote: A General GRE score is required for applications for Fall 2027.

gre_subject.value: The Physics Subject Test may be submitted but is completely optional.
gre_subject.quote: The Physics Subject Test may be submitted as part of the application, but is completely optional.
